area.definition: Union of legal standard-cell sites and native PCell bounds, divided by the measured OA outline. Signal metal and density fill are excluded from occupied device area.

routing.method: Native 12-track standard cells and custom RC/clear placement in Virtuoso. Innovus detailed signal routing, local DRC repairs, shared diffusion in four clear-device pairs, and M6 supply trunks.

qualification.scope: Closed-loop 8-bit ADC at 10 MS/s with extracted SAR and schematic analog blocks
qualification.receiver_skew_measurement: Linear interpolation at VDD/2 at each of eight physical clock gates
